_comment: X = times you've boosted -> COUNT_BOOSTS (boost appends one marker per boost). APPROXIMATION: the card says 'this COMBAT CHAIN' but the marker is TURN-scoped, so on a multi-attack turn this over-counts. Recorded rather than hidden; an exact fix needs a chain-scoped boost counter. Removed a FLAG_SET 'BOOST_FLAG' gate: the flag was invented AND the text has no such condition — 'when this attacks a hero, they reveal X cards' happens unconditionally, with X simply 0 if you have not boosted.
